exposure: skin-to-skin contact (SSC) with fathers during transfer of preterm infants from delivery room to NICU
incubator transfers of preterm infants from delivery room to NICU
outcome: delay in the first SSC in the NICU
hypothermia at admission in the NICU
cohort: The study included preterm singletons born between May and December 2019 who did not require invasive ventilation.
finding: SSC transfer of preterm infants was feasible and promoted earlier SSC in the neonatal unit and breastfeeding at discharge, despite inducing moderate heat losses similar to incubator transfers that exacerbated hypothermia at NICU admission.
